title: v2 finalization failure is swallowed by legacy success
description: runner.run calls finalize_world but logs the FinalizeResult without checking fin.ok, and swallows v2 finalize exceptions. run() returns config_hash on every non-exception path.
resolution: M4-2: when FW_CONTEXT_V2_WRITE_AUTHORITY=1, fin.ok==False raises IndexIntegrityError (CASE D); v2 finalize exceptions re-raise as IndexIntegrityError (CASE C). Scanner confirms raises_on_failure=True.

title: reindex_file_impl bypasses v2 entirely
description: reindex_file_impl wrote legacy semantic data via store_symbols_for_unit with NO certify_and_publish_for_unit, NO bind_tu, NO finalize_world.
resolution: M4-4: added Phase 2.5 v2 leg to _reindex_parse_and_store — builds world_ctx, calls certify_and_publish_for_unit per TU, finalizes the v2 World. When v2 write-authority is on, v2 failure propagates.

title: v2 master flag defaults OFF — production runs LEGACY_PRIMARY
description: shadow_v2_enabled defaults False (env FW_CONTEXT_SHADOW_V2). Production today runs LEGACY_PRIMARY. V2_PRIMARY_LEGACY_MIRROR must become the default write mode.
resolution: M4-7: flipped v2_write_authority default from False to True. Scanner confirms DEFAULT_WRITE_MODE=V2_PRIMARY_LEGACY_MIRROR. Production now runs v2-primary by default.

title: Legacy postprocess can abort a v2-successful run
description: _step_verify_integrity raises IndexIntegrityError after v2 finalization; 'raise aborted' propagates and aborts the run (CASE B violation).
resolution: M4-5: when _v2_write_authority_on() is True, 'raise aborted' is replaced with log.warning + ctx['legacy_compatibility_degraded']=True (SUCCESS + LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_DEGRADED). Scanner confirms postprocess_degraded=True.
